scope: Required actual-Linux directory durability boundaries; synthetic signed attempt, not live chain or host power-loss acceptance

requiredTests: Linux directory durability: nested bootstrap fences leaf and ancestor names before returning
Linux directory durability: byte-identical return retains inode but fences directory metadata
Linux directory durability: version migration fences published state
Linux directory durability: post-rename fence failure leaves visible immutable state but suppresses the dependent action
Linux directory durability: directory-open errors are not silently swallowed
Linux directory durability: directory-close errors are not silently swallowed
Linux directory durability: primary mutation and durability failures preserve both errors and status
Linux directory durability: write sync close and directory failures retain every cause
Linux directory durability: lock-close failure retains its marker while reporting the failure
Linux directory durability: post-rename signed-wire failure cannot broadcast or replace its saved attempt
